cmd: a=$(awk '/enp0s6/{print $2, $10}' /proc/net/dev); sleep 30; b=$(awk '/enp0s6/{print $2, $10}' /proc/net/dev); echo before $a after $b | awk '{printf "rate over 30s: rx %.1f KB/s tx %.1f KB/s\n", ($4-$2)/30/1024, ($5-$3)/30/1024}'; echo ---SS; ss -tinpH state established 2>/dev/null | awk '/users:/{match($0,/\(\("[^"]+"/); n=substr($0,RSTART+3,RLENGTH-4); cur=n} /bytes_received/{match($0,/bytes_received:[0-9]+/); v=substr($0,RSTART+15,RLENGTH-15); s[cur]+=v; c[cur]++} END{for(k in s) printf "%s conns=%d recv=%.1fMB\n",k,c[k],s[k]/1e6}'; echo ---CONNS; ss -tnpH state established 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $4}' | sed 's/.*://' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -8; echo ---LOGS; ls -laS /var/log/vps-*.log /opt/trading-bot/*/*.log 2>/dev/null | head -8 | awk '{print $5, $9}' 2>&1 | LC_ALL=C tr -cd '\11\12\40-\176'
